verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents screening customers against an Adverse Media database and reviewing the resulting alerts and risks in its case management, in the web app or via API. However, nothing in the evidence shows adverse-media matches linked to source evidence such as articles, or risk-category taxonomies for those matches. missing for 10: linked source evidence (articles/URLs) on adverse-media matches, adverse-media risk categories, independent or hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can review adverse-media matches with linked evidence and risk categories

citations.quote: Politically Exposed Persons registers (PEPs) and Adverse Media
Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API
